first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both declining, and the inherited onboarding result directly addresses the larger combined funnel problem while supporting sustainable revenue better than immediately matching competitor pricing. Verify the onboarding and activation evidence, while checking the pricing record to understand the competitive tradeoff. Run a guarded test measuring completion, activation, qualified pipeline, retention proxies, and revenue quality—not just conversion.

final.rationale: Run a guarded onboarding simplification experiment because completion is down 4% and the verified result improved completion, reduced time-to-value, and increased 30-day retention. This offers stronger evidence for sustainable long-term qualified revenue than promotional pricing, whose 40% discount produced a 12% retention decline despite short-term revenue growth. Measure onboarding completion, activation, time-to-value, qualified revenue, and 30-day retention, with guardrails against lower-quality cohorts. Activation messaging is a credible follow-up but is less directly supported on durable retention and the single slot should target the broader funnel constraint.
